The caveat fix is not complete: the table's legend (line 11) and the doc comment of the Unconfined standing in RuntimeCapabilities.cs:14 still define unconfined as 'a shell is always there', and the new kimi rows contradict that.
The Scopes class and the StandIn helper are copied verbatim from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests into both new test classes (three copies now) instead of being shared.
S5.5.1 never asserts E5.5 decision 3 (the confinement recorded on the check is empty), and it proves 'scratch and canary unchanged' only through the check's own 'answered' state.
In S5.6.7, the 'refused before the launch' arm asserts only that coai-vh\<8> is gone, not the row's scratch; deviation 60 records this gap honestly.
The doc comment on Records still names only the question-consultant run and the Vibe probe, although the list now also holds the Kimi record.
